findings.title: QueryClient.clear() static call crashes logout
findings.problem: Imports QueryClient class and calls QueryClient.clear() as a static method. clear() is an instance method, so this throws TypeError on every logout attempt.
findings.fix: Import useQueryClient hook, call queryClient.clear() on the instance returned by the hook.

findings.title: Feed realtime invalidation key mismatch — feature silently broken
findings.problem: useFeed uses queryKey ['userFeed'] but useFeedRealtime invalidates ['feed']. Keys never match, so realtime feed updates are completely broken.
findings.fix: Align both hooks to use the same key: ['feed', currentUser?.id].

findings.title: useCurrentUser is non-reactive — components don't rerender on auth changes
findings.problem: Uses queryClient.getQueryData() which is synchronous and non-reactive. Components using this hook don't rerender when the cached user changes on login/logout.
findings.fix: Replace with useQuery({ queryKey: ['currentUser'], queryFn: () => null, staleTime: Infinity, gcTime: Infinity }).

findings.title: useFeedRealtime — Supabase channel torn down every render
findings.problem: useEffect depends on [followingIds] — an array reference that changes every render. The Supabase realtime channel is destroyed and recreated continuously.
findings.fix: Serialize the dependency: const followingKey = followingIds?.join(','), depend on [followingKey].

findings.title: Hidden tab panels mount all children and fire all hooks
findings.problem: TabPanel hides inactive tabs with CSS (className='hidden') but still renders all children. ScoresTab, FriendActivityTab, and SeasonsTab hooks all fire on mount — ~3 wasted API calls per detail page visit.
findings.fix: Change TabPanel to return null when activeTab !== id. Only render the active tab's children.

findings.title: Query keys missing userId — cross-user cache pollution
findings.problem: Multiple hooks omit currentUser.id from query keys. If User A logs out and User B logs in, User B sees User A's cached ratings, feed, and relationship data.
findings.fix: Add currentUser?.id to each query key array.

findings.title: MediaCard — 80 duplicate query subscriptions per page
findings.problem: Every MediaCard independently calls useInteractions('favorite') and useInteractions('watchlist'). With 40 cards on BrowsePage, that's 80 active query listeners. Any favorites/watchlist change rerenders all 40 cards simultaneously.
findings.fix: Lift interactions to parent (BrowsePage/MediaRow). Compute favoritedSet and watchlistedSet once with useMemo, pass boolean props to each card.

findings.title: AppLayout inline Outlet context causes full page rerenders
findings.problem: <Outlet context={{ session }} /> creates a new object reference on every render. All child pages using useOutletContext() rerender on any AppLayout state change.
findings.fix: Memoize: const outletContext = useMemo(() => ({ session }), [session])

findings.title: No route-level code splitting
findings.problem: All 10 page components are statically imported. The entire app ships as one JS bundle — auth pages, settings, detail page, etc. loaded upfront even if user never visits them.
findings.fix: Use React.lazy() + Suspense for route-level components. Wrap routes with appropriate skeleton fallbacks.

findings.title: Season data refetches every accordion toggle
findings.problem: No staleTime set. Opening/closing a season accordion unmounts/remounts SeasonEpisodes, retriggering the TMDB fetch. Season episode data is essentially static.
findings.fix: Added staleTime: Infinity and gcTime: 1000 * 60 * 60. Created useAllSeasonDetails hook to bulk-fetch all seasons in parallel on Seasons tab click, pre-populating cache for instant accordion toggling.

findings.title: useSearch gcTime < staleTime — cache purged while still fresh
findings.problem: gcTime is 30s while staleTime inherits 5min from defaults. Cache is garbage collected before it goes stale, forcing unnecessary refetches.
findings.fix: Set staleTime: 1000 * 60 * 1 and gcTime: 1000 * 60 * 5.

findings.title: React.memo missing on list item components
findings.problem: Grid/list item components are not wrapped in React.memo. Every parent rerender rerenders all items even if props haven't changed.
findings.fix: Wrap each component in React.memo(). For EpisodeRow and SeasonAccordion, wrap the internal functions.

findings.title: useUserSearch fires Supabase query on every keystroke
findings.problem: Unlike useSearch which uses useDebounce, useUserSearch fires a query per keystroke once searchQuery.length >= 2. Typing a 10-character name fires 9 requests.
findings.fix: Add useDebounce(searchQuery, 300) and use the debounced value for the query key and enabled check.

findings.title: No image lazy loading across the app
findings.problem: All tags load eagerly, including off-screen images in long lists and feeds. No loading='lazy' or decoding='async' attributes.
findings.fix: Add loading='lazy' and decoding='async' to all secondary/list images. Keep above-the-fold hero images eager.

findings.title: No optimistic updates on rating mutations
findings.problem: Rating mutations wait for the full Supabase round-trip before the UI updates. User sees a delay between clicking rate and seeing the result.
findings.fix: Add onMutate for instant feedback with optimistic cache update, onError for rollback, onSettled for invalidation.

findings.title: useFocusTrap — addEventListener never called
findings.problem: useEffect cleanup removes the keydown listener, but addEventListener is never called inside the effect body. Focus trapping is completely non-functional.
findings.fix: Add modal.addEventListener('keydown', handleTab) inside the useEffect before the cleanup return.

findings.title: useIntersectionObserver — observer recreated every render
findings.problem: Default parameter options = {} creates a new object reference each render. IntersectionObserver disconnects and reconnects continuously.
findings.fix: Destructure scalar defaults: { rootMargin = '200px', threshold = 0 } = {}. Depend on scalar values instead of object.

findings.title: Request waterfall: useMediaDetails blocks useExternalApis
findings.problem: DetailPage blocks render with skeleton until useMediaDetails finishes. Only then does ScoresTab mount and fire useExternalApis — sequential waterfall.
findings.fix: Hoist useExternalApis(data?.imdb_id) into DetailPage so it starts fetching as soon as imdb_id is available from useMediaDetails.

findings.title: handleRate depends on full data object — breaks memoization
findings.problem: useCallback depends on data (full media object). Every React Query refetch creates a new data reference, creating a new handleRate function, and rerendering ActionSection.
findings.fix: Extract data?.title and data?.poster_path into variables. Depend on primitive values instead of the full object.

findings.title: Isolate hook-heavy ActionSection to prevent DetailPage rerenders
findings.problem: isWatchlisted/isFavorited depend on watchlist/favorites queries. When these arrays change reference (background refetch), the entire DetailPage and all children rerender.
findings.fix: Create an ActionSectionContainer component that owns the interaction hooks, isolating rerenders from the rest of the page.

findings.title: useUpdateProfile invalidation does nothing
findings.problem: Calls invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['currentUser'] }), but ['currentUser'] has no queryFn — invalidation triggers nothing. Profile updates don't reflect in UI.
findings.fix: Use queryClient.setQueryData(['currentUser'], updatedUser) in onSuccess instead.

findings.title: useRemoveAvatar over-invalidates all profiles globally
findings.problem: Invalidates ['profile'] globally, forcing all cached profile queries across all users to refetch.
findings.fix: Scope to current user: queryClient.invalidateQueries({ queryKey: ['profile', currentUser?.id] }).

findings.title: useProfileData / useInteractions staleTime: Infinity prevents background refetch
findings.problem: staleTime: Infinity permanently prevents background refetching. If a mutation misses an invalidation, data stays stale for the entire session.
findings.fix: Replace Infinity with a long but finite staleTime (e.g. 5 minutes).

findings.title: TMDB image sizes not optimized — oversized images for thumbnails
findings.problem: 64px thumbnail containers fetch w500 images from TMDB. ~90% of image payload is wasted. Especially bad on mobile.
findings.fix: Create getTmdbImageUrl(path, size) helper. Use w92/w185 for thumbnails, w342 for cards, w500 for detail posters.

findings.title: No list virtualization for infinite scroll
findings.problem: Infinite scroll lists render all accumulated cards in the DOM. As pagination grows, DOM node count and memory increase linearly.
findings.fix: Implement virtualization with @tanstack/react-virtual when items exceed ~20.

findings.title: Case-sensitive import path bug — CommunityPage build failure on Linux
findings.problem: Imports 'userSearchWidget' (lowercase) but the file on disk is 'UserSearchWidget.jsx'. Works on macOS but fails on case-sensitive filesystems (Linux CI/CD, Docker, Vercel).
findings.fix: Fix import to: import UserSearchWidget from '../../features/social/components/UserSearchWidget'.

findings.title: new Date() instantiated per episode row per render
findings.problem: EpisodeRow constructs new Date() for every row on every render. For 24 episodes, that's 24 Date constructions per render pass.
findings.fix: Compute 'now' once at SeasonEpisodes level (const now = Date.now()) and pass to rows, or use ISO string comparison.

findings.title: Static style/variant objects recreated inside component bodies
findings.problem: Variant maps, size maps, position maps, and toastOptions are defined inside component function bodies and recreated on every render.
findings.fix: Move these static objects to module scope (above the component function).

findings.title: Unmemoized country list and genre lookups
findings.problem: getCountryOptions() called every render (Intl.DisplayNames + sort). getGenreNames() called per search result item without useMemo. formattedCountries in OverviewTab also unmemoized.
findings.fix: Compute country options once at module scope. Wrap genre lookups in useMemo. Merge formattedCountries into existing useMemo block.

findings.title: ProfileHero date formatting on every render
findings.problem: memberSince calls new Date().toLocaleDateString() with locale options on every render. toLocaleDateString is expensive due to Intl initialization.
findings.fix: Wrap in useMemo(() => ..., [profileData?.created_at]).
